name: imageserver-generation-safe-cache-publication
instr:
imageserver cannot stop stale fills overwriting newer cache publications. Add comparable generations that follow the winning image through caches, server composition, Groupcache, and HTTP validation without breaking legacy storage or requests.

`cache.Generation` distinguishes misses, legacy values, and versioned `cache.Snapshot` values. `Snapshot.MarshalBinary` and `Snapshot.UnmarshalBinary` copy owned data, round-trip envelopes, and read every raw Image payload unchanged. Conditional publication returns `cache.Publication` with exported `Snapshot *Snapshot` and `Stored bool` fields. Conflicts return the winner through `cache.ErrGenerationConflict`, exactly `errors.New("cache generation conflict")`.

Memory must compare and replace atomically, isolate returned snapshots, and count complete envelopes without changing eviction. File publication must be atomic, leaving the prior image readable after interruption. Memcache must use server-observed identity, distinguish eviction after observation from creation after a miss, and never turn replacement or CAS conflicts into overwrites. Redis must atomically compare generations and replace envelopes, preserve expiry, report misses as absent, and expose transport failures. `cache.ConditionalFunc`, `cache.ConditionalCache.GetSnapshot`, and `cache.ConditionalCache.Publish` must not treat unsupported publication as ordinary `Set`.

`cache.NewServer` and `cache.Server.GetVersioned` must observe before filling and return the winner. `imag
